newsitem.title: POLAND: Elektrim confirms will buy Rafako shrs.
newsitem.headline: Elektrim confirms will buy Rafako shrs.

text.p: Polish industrial and trading firm Elektrim SA has reaffirmed its plan to buy 8.1 million new shares of industrial boilermaker Rafako at 11.25 zlotys each, Rafako said in a statement on Tuesday.
The purchase would give Elektrim a 46-percent stake.

Rafako shares were worth 13 zlotys on the Warsaw bourse on July 11 when the exchange suspended their trade for an indefinite period of time due to heavy flooding at the company's plant in Raciborz, southern Poland.
Rafako said on Monday it was currently appraising flood damage. It said it would resume some production on August 1 and return to full production capacity in September.
